messages:
liam_support: FYI — incoming customer request from Acme Health. Ticket #5482. They want to stream partial function-call arguments so their toolchain can start work before the model finishes generating the full JSON. They're hitting token/cost limits and need low-latency partials.
liam_support: customer example (they pasted into ticket):
```
event 1 -> {"type": "fn_call", "name": "patient_lookup", "args_partial": "{\"query\": \"john doe\"}"}
event 2 -> {"type": "fn_call", "args_partial": "{\"filter\": \"recent\"}"}
```
They want these as actionable frames to stream into their existing tool that accepts incremental JSON patches.

emma_product: Thanks — good catch. Quick clarifying q's: (1) do they need each partial to be valid JSON on its own or is an ordered patch stream OK? (2) which SDKs do they use (python/node)? (3) acceptance criteria — must the server guarantee schema-validated partials or is that post-processing on client OK? :thinking_face:

raj_eng_runtime: Short answer: feasible but nontrivial. Current streamer emits text tokens only; our fn_call acceptance expects the full `arguments` blob as one piece. Two implementation approaches:
- A: boundary frames: emit discrete frames labeled `fn_call_partial` with raw string payload. Minimal protocol change, client must assemble.
- B: fragment-aware structured frames: each frame is JSON fragment and server attempts to reassemble/validate incrementally. More complex; requires parser additions and careful error handling.
Estimate: prototype of A = ~1 week. Ship MVP (server+SDK hooks+tests) = ~6 weeks. Approach B adds 3–4 weeks and more tests.

sofia_sales: Acme says timeline is end of Q2 for a pilot. They're open to a revenue-backed pilot if we can prioritize. This would be a strategic health-care case (HIPAA/PII). They already use Dedicated.

mike_devex: SDK impact: we need to add a streaming callback variant that surfaces `fn_call_partial` frames and an iterator/generator helper that assembles partials into a final `arguments` object. Python/node both need changes and doc examples + migration guide. I can scope docs + samples once eng confirms frame shape.

ticket-bot: Ticket #5482 created by liam_support in support. Assigned to product triage.

emma_product: Proposed scope for MVP (to keep risk low):
1) Introduce a `fn_call_partial` envelope event in the stream with `frame_id` and `is_final` flags. Payload is opaque string for MVP.
2) SDKs expose `on_fn_call_partial(frame)` callback and an `assemble_fn_call_frames(frames)` helper.
3) Acceptance criteria:
   - Customer can receive and reassemble partial frames into a valid `arguments` JSON identical to the final server output.
   - No regressions for existing customers (current clients that expect single `fn_call` still work).
   - Telemetry emits counts of partial frames and percent of sessions using partials.
Rollout: beta opt-in + targeted pilot with Acme, feature-flagged by account.

raj_eng_runtime: Confirming MVP approach aligns with my estimate. Notes: we must add a compatibility layer so older SDKs see the full `fn_call` at the end if they don't opt in. Perf impact small but need end-to-end tests (parser, env escape cases) and load testing on dedicated pools. I'll add a prototype task and bench it.

liam_support: I'll ask Acme for throughput expectations (calls/sec), sample logs, and whether they can adopt SDK changes for the pilot. I'll update ticket with their consent to pilot and estimated go/no-go dates.

emma_product: Nice. Action items:
- raj_eng_runtime: prototype A (frame envelope) and bench — due in 1 week.
- mike_devex: draft SDK API surface + migration guide — due in 10 days.
- liam_support: update ticket with customer throughput + pilot commitment and add as "pilot candidate".
- sofia_sales: confirm contract / pilot funding possibility and compliance checklist (HIPAA).
I'll create JIRA INF-7623 and link to #5482. Prioritization note: if Acme signs a paid pilot, move to high priority. :thumbsup:

raj_eng_runtime: Ack — will create a feature branch and post prototype logs to the thread when ready. Also will add a small compatibility test matrix.

liam_support: Added Acme notes to #5482 and pinged them for sample client code. Marking this thread as product-triage. Thanks everyone.
